$comment: Acceptance criteria for GATE-6. Declared, never inferred (ADR-017).
amendment_reason: The original criterion required file_exists adapters/beads. That was mis-specified against reference/criteria.md 62, which permits 'Beads OR synthetic execution provider'. Amended to require an execution adapter, not specifically the Beads one. Recorded rather than silently edited: amending criteria to make work pass is how a completion firewall gets defeated, and ADR-017 names criteria drift as a known negative consequence.
